mcp_tool_configuration.title: MCP Tool Configuration Required
mcp_tool_configuration.message:
Some alternative AI providers don't fully support deferred tool loading (tool search).

To fix this:
1. Open Settings ({{shortcut}})
2. Go to "Claude Code" panel
3. In the "Environment Variables" section, add:
   ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH = false
4. Save and retry your request

figma_mcp.title: Figma MCP server needs reconfiguration
figma_mcp.message:
Your current Figma MCP configuration will not work in Nimbalyst. Figma does not allow OAuth-based MCP in certain apps.

To fix it, open MCP settings and follow these steps:

1. Remove the existing OAuth Figma MCP configuration.
2. Add a new Figma MCP configuration from the Nimbalyst MCP template.
3. Add your Personal Access Token to the MCP configuration.

A fresh database has been created. Your old data has been backed up to:

database_recovery.ambiguous_lock_message: Cannot tell whether another Nimbalyst is already running.
database_recovery.ambiguous_lock_detail:
Nimbalyst found a database lock from a few seconds ago and cannot confirm whether the process holding it (PID {{pid}}, host {{hostname}}, acquired {{timestamp}}) is still alive. Two scenarios are equally likely:

  1. Another Nimbalyst window is open under a different user account or privilege level. Opening anyway will run two instances against the same database and may corrupt data.

  2. A previous Nimbalyst crashed less than a minute ago and the OS has already reused the original PID for a system process. In this case the lock is safe to clear.

If unsure, choose Cancel and look for another Nimbalyst window before retrying.
database_recovery.delete_copy_rollback_detail: {{name}} ({{size}}) is the copy Nimbalyst would restore from if you rolled back to PGLite. Deleting it removes that option permanently. Your current database is not affected.
database_recovery.delete_copy_preserved_detail: {{name}} ({{size}}) is a preserved copy of your database from before the switch to SQLite. Deleting it frees the space permanently. Your current database is not affected.
